 BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Singapore Takes Over Sentosa with Drone Shows, Fan Village, Beach Parties and Exclusive Experiences 
 by Irone Kim November 15, 2026 4 minute read 
 57 SHARES Share Tweet Linkedin Weibo Line Telegram 
 Sentosa Island is set to become the largest single destination for BTS THE CITY ARIRANG SINGAPORE this December, with Sentosa Development Corporation (SDC) and Resorts World Sentosa (RWS) joining forces to bring fans an island-wide celebration inspired by the global K-pop group.
 Running from 4 to 31 December 2026 across Sentosa, and until 3 January 2027 at Resorts World Sentosa, the programme will feature immersive installations, beachside activities, a dedicated fan village, after-dark entertainment, themed dining and exclusive hotel stays.
 Fans can explore BTS-themed installations and photo opportunities across the island, participate in the BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Stamp Rally through Weverse, and connect with fellow fans at dedicated gathering spaces. The stamp rally will be available at Sentosa Beach Station Guest Services and Resorts World Sentosa.
 The experience begins even before visitors reach the island, with themed Sentosa Express trains and cable cars on the Sentosa Line featuring three different BTS THE CITY ARIRANG designs. Specially wrapped buses will also transport fans to Resorts World Sentosa, featuring designs inspired by BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Night Out at Universal Studios Singapore and the BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Fan Village.
 One of the main attractions will be a nearly 10-metre-tall BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Giant Inflatable at Palawan Beach, featuring a large-scale pixel art design. The installation will serve as a focal point for the island’s celebrations.
 During the day, Palawan Beach will become a gathering spot for fans, with parasols, beachside activities and DJs playing popular music. From 18 to 20 December, the celebrations will expand with the BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Rave & Drone Party at Sentosa, featuring local K-pop DJ and Waterbomb Singapore performer DJ RAW.
 As night falls, the skies above Palawan Beach will light up with a BTS-themed drone performance featuring 1,500 drones, accompanied by BTS music. The show is presented in partnership with Visa.
 Fans looking for a more active experience can also register for the BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Run at Sentosa on 12 December. The 3km run will feature popular BTS songs along the route and conclude at Palawan Green, where participants can take photographs at dedicated BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Photo Points.
 Runners will receive exclusive race pack merchandise, including T-shirts, bags and swimming floats. After completing the run, participants can continue the celebrations at the BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Rave featuring DJ RAW.
 Across Sentosa, five BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Photo Points will offer opportunities for fans to capture their visit. Located at spots including Central Beach Bazaar and Palawan Green, the installations will feature creative elements such as convex-mirror walls and surfboards.
 Themed around Escape, Play, Unwind and Explore, the installations are designed to create distinctive photo opportunities by playfully distorting and fragmenting visitors’ surroundings.
 At Sensoryscape, fans can also relax on BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Tape Hammocks, while Symphony Streams and Scented Sphere will incorporate music into the garden’s multisensory environment. Selected island partners will also introduce themed experiences, with further details to be announced through Sentosa’s website.
 Over at Resorts World Sentosa, the celebrations will include a dedicated BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Fan Village, an after-hours event at Universal Studios Singapore, themed hotel packages and special food offerings.
 The official BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Fan Village will operate from 16 to 22 December at the Resorts World Convention Centre. Designed as an experiential gathering space, it will feature interactive activities, themed installations and opportunities for fans to connect.
 One of the featured activities is TEAM ON THE RUN!, a separately ticketed team challenge where participants work together to complete a series of interactive missions. Each participant will receive a team memento, while every team will receive a complimentary commemorative photograph.
 The Fan Village will also feature a welcome tunnel, a large-scale Music Box installation and dedicated spaces for fans to gather.
 Visitors can explore three themed areas known as the PLAY, TASTE and BEAUTY Zones. These will include photo booths, food and beverage offerings combining Korean favourites with Singapore flavours, as well as opportunities to personalise their appearance with hair tinsels and face gems.
 Fans can also redeem exclusive themed gifts with qualifying purchases at participating Fan Village outlets and through selected passes, attraction tickets and hotel stays. These limited-edition keepsakes are available while stocks last.
 For fans who want to continue the celebrations into the night, BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Night Out at Universal Studios Singapore will take place on 21 December from 8pm to 1am.
 The special after-hours event will offer access to selected rides, specially curated food and beverage options, and music by K-pop DJ sensation DJ JAGI.
 The night will also feature a BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Fireworks show, with fireworks set to themed music. Another highlight is BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Lightscape, a projection-mapping presentation illuminating the iconic Revenge of the Mummy façade with specially curated content.
 Fans can also participate in trivia sessions and fan challenges for opportunities to win prizes.
 Beyond the special event on 21 December, BTS-themed fireworks will be presented on selected nights at Universal Studios Singapore from 4 December 2026 to 2 January 2027. The BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Lightscape projection show will take place nightly from 7.30pm between 4 December 2026 and 3 January 2027.
 Those looking to make their visit a longer getaway can book the BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Stay Experience at Hotel Ora and Equarius Hotel. Fans can also opt for the BTS THE CITY ARIRANG: Signature Stay Experience at The Laurus.
 The curated hotel packages will include themed in-room touches, such as specially designed room keycards and exclusive take-home merchandise, extending the BTS experience beyond the island’s attractions.
 Food will also be part of the celebration, with Resorts World Sentosa introducing a limited-edition BTS THE CITY ARIRANG: RWS Flavours in Harmony signature sharing box priced at S$45++.
 The sharing box combines Korean and local flavours, featuring Mala Gochujang Beef Skewers, Golden Yuja Prawn and Bulgogi Cod. Dessert comes in the form of Berry Muscat Crystal Mousse, made with vanilla mascarpone, raspberry glaze, muscat grapes and grape jelly crystals.
 The special sharing box will be available at selected Resorts World Sentosa dining outlets, including Horatio, Syun, Quan and Kamon.
